decisions.reason: The existing same-message event correctly adds cross-user rendering consistency, but it overgeneralizes the decision to all template rendering; the supplied context specifically concerns bullet sizes and spacing.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: What can we do to ensure everyone else sees exactly what we see?

value_updates.cross_user_rendering_consistency: Bullet sizes and spacing should render consistently for other users rather than appearing different on their screens.

decisions.reason: Cross-user consistency of bullet sizes and spacing does not change Tab-driven sublevel creation or list-hierarchy behavior.
The source concerns cross-user rendering of graphic bullets, not spacing produced by hard returns in continuous paragraph text.
Consistent visual rendering across users does not alter the Enter-key trigger for creating a new bullet.
The source does not change alignment behavior for numbered lists reaching multi-digit values.
The decision about consistent bullet rendering across users does not change which theme colors are included or offered.
The source does not affect alignment of the Board Meeting Item and Title field.
The source does not affect borders or formatting created when inserting a Board Meeting row.
The cross-user bullet-rendering decision does not change the date-entry control or its template coverage.
The source does not change placeholder-clearing behavior or the fields to which that behavior applies.
The source concerns bullet appearance across users and does not change text wrapping or adjacent-column stability.
The source does not change the Guidance template's fixed-margin or pencil-icon visibility requirements.
